outlook.statement: With the integration of the newly acquired Aqua Feed business, we expect to strengthen our market presence in all the states, improve margins, and generate sustainable value for our stakeholders. We will also focus on optimising capacity utilisation of the acquired facilities and exploring further expansion opportunities. At the same time, enhancing the operational efficiency and performance of each business division remains a key priority.

We are actively looking at 2-3 projects relating to Glycerine, Bio Gas etc for our growth. We will close atleast one of them by Q3 of this financial year. We also plan to expand the capacity of the feed manufacturing in next 1-2 years, once we fully utilise the capacities available in the existing plants in Andhra.
During the current financial year, focus will be to grow the business and achieve break even for the IFB Vietnam value-added seafood project.
Sale of Ethanol from newly commissioned 25 KLPD plant will start in FY 26-27 once new tenders are floated by Oil Marketing Companies.

Acquisition of Cargill's aquaculture feed business expected to strengthen presence in high-potential aquaculture sector; focus on improving operational efficiencies, optimizing cost structures, and strengthening market positioning.
Branded retail marine domestic food business growing 90% YoY, with potential to grow brand Pan-India through Q-com & E-com; company continues to invest in product innovation and marketing.
IFB Vietnam Company Ltd transitioned to initial commercial operations; first shipment in April 2026; facility operational and aligned with international quality and food safety standards.

Alcohol business faces challenges due to excess ENA capacity in the state, increased demand for non-edible grain by ethanol plants, leading to margin impact from excess supply, higher grain prices, and lower ENA and by-product prices.
Aqua feed business faces severe challenges as input prices increased significantly but cannot be passed to consumers because Andhra Pradesh Government has not allowed shrimp feed price increases.
Export business more challenging due to geopolitical uncertainties increasing pricing dynamics, higher ocean freight, and delivery delays from shipping line unavailability.
Company remains cautiously optimistic, aligning strategies to capitalize on emerging opportunities while mitigating external risks.
Feed manufacturing project at Balasore kept in abeyance due to recent acquisition.

During 2026-27, efforts directed towards growing acquired aqua feed business, ensuring improved margins and better returns on capital employed through better procurement of key raw materials (non-edible rice, shrimps) and tight control over overheads.
Focus on making value added project in Vietnam successful.
Company focused on resource allocation and looking for further expansion in Marine business.
Continuing efforts to attain further efficiencies by process/technological improvements, reduction of wastages, and optimal use of human resources in all divisions.

Many more value-added products are in the pipeline to cater Aqua Health Care Products (AHCP) segmental requirements. More such products are in the pipeline with the introduction of prebiotics and useful minerals.
The MCSA system deployed for critical motors in CO2 plant area may be deployed to other critical functions gradually.
